scope: REM-028-S025 through REM-028-S027: SessionStore.fork history reads

production_calls.observation: Public deprecated compatibility method delegates to the deprecated range reader and is not a new history seam.
Synchronous fork validates the current/default boundary, exact event identity and contiguous seq, then folds the selected prefix to reject an open turn.

fork_acceptance: An omitted boundary selects the current last event, while an empty source creates an empty seed.
An explicit boundary is inclusive and must identify an existing contiguous event.
A selected prefix ending after turn/start without turn/end is rejected before child creation.
The inherited prefix is copied into a detached child seed and the constructor adds session/end-seed.
Unknown, stale, duplicate, invalid-boundary, and open-turn failures remain synchronous and leave no child registered.

own_events.decision: Retain the public method as an existing deprecated compatibility API.
own_events.reason: The method exposes a complete synchronous child-owned suffix and cannot be replaced by a new synchronous alias without preserving the storage-residency dependency prohibited by the deprecation decision.
own_events.condition_for_removal: Remove or migrate existing callers only after an explicit storage-backed inherited-prefix reader is available and each owner proves equivalent fork/resume semantics.

fork.decision: Retain SessionStore.fork as a named complete-history exception; do not add a wrapper or a new synchronous fork-cut reader in A15.
fork.reason: Fork needs an exact complete prefix and must synchronously reject invalid boundaries and open turns before registering a child. The current core API cannot await storage I/O, and adding a Session method that exposes the same synchronous history would violate the active policy.
fork.future_capability: A future storage-owned complete/inherited-prefix fork-cut capability must provide a fixed cut, exact event identity, contiguous prefix ordering, inherited count, open-turn validation, cancellation/error propagation, and a caller contract that permits asynchronous storage access or an already loaded cut. Core must not add a session-query dependency.
fork.preserved_behavior: Any successor must preserve inclusive boundaries, empty-source behavior, detached seed ownership, session/end-seed construction, lineage metadata, and synchronous failure-before-child-registration semantics at the public operation that remains synchronous.

next_action.summary: Design the remaining W1 session-telemetry and session-title historical-read successor seams
next_action.scope: REM-028-S071 through S073 in session-telemetry and session-title, including bounded suffix capture, all-prompts title history, and synchronous pre-commit citation
next_action.completion_signal: Each remaining caller has an owner decision, no dependency cycle is introduced, and any implementation successor has explicit fixed-cut, ordering, cancellation, and veto semantics before a production gate

limitations: The canonical audit-metrics command remains unavailable on the incomplete current worktree because tracked source paths are absent.
Full doc-sync retains the four previously recorded catalog/tool-composition failures.
This design does not change production source, released Session data, the sealed candidate, or publication state.
